info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List It Management Internal Network Operations-spec
info.description: The Internal Network Operations API provides access to vital functionalities for managing and monitoring internal network operations within the banking sector. It allows users to retrieve comprehensive lists of ongoing and completed network operations, ensuring efficient oversight and control. This API is beneficial for IT management teams and network administrators who require detailed insights to maintain operational integrity and performance. Through efficient data access, the API supports the overall enhancement of internal IT services and infrastructure management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding internal network operations within the IT management system. Utilize this endpoint to monitor, analyze, and manage your internal network processes efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body requires a JSON object that specifies parameters for the internal network operation. Ensure that the provided parameters comply with the defined schema.
